An anchor split around a block keeps the half that carries its text

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<a href=\"/o\">Text<div><a href=\"/i\">Inner</a></div></a>", options = ConversionOptions$default())
print(result$content)
```
